exact_statement: For every regular unate Boolean core h on q uniform bits, every vertex-disjoint collection of stars with centers j and leaves L_j, and arbitrary degree-at-most-two F2 phases a_i on m independent uniform control bits, put y_j=x_j product_i_in_Lj x_i at centers and y_i=x_i elsewhere, and G=h(y_i a_i). The accepted latent rank reference pushed through the invertible spectral star map is normalized and satisfies H(G)<=Gamma_R(G)<=C_reg I(h)+2I_z(G)<=C_reg I_x(G)+2I_z(G), C_reg=log2(4+e)+2log2(e*pi). Exactly I_x(G)=I(h)+sum_j sum_i_in_Lj [Inf_j(h)-2 sum_S_containing_i_j hhat(S)^2], and every summand is the nonnegative probability that j is pivotal at both i endpoints. The example MAJ3(x1,x1*x2,x3) is nonunate, has H=2,I=3/2 and admits no fixed-order, fixed-orientation predecessor-antichain geometry. No arbitrary iterated/overlapping-star, tag-deletion or centered-influence claim is made.

exact_statement: For every n>=0 and every two quadratic Boolean phases g0,g1 on the same uniform physical n-bit cube, G(z,y)=g_z(y) has selector entropy decrement L=H(G)-(H(g0)+H(g1))/2 <= (12-(9/2)log2(3))*Inf_z(G), and H(G) <= (16/3-(3/2)log2(3))*I(G). Both constants are attained by g0=1 and g1=(-1)^(y0*y1). The admitted distinct-label quadratic affine-row function f(x,z,y)=(-1)^(xz+zy0y1) restricts at x=0 to this witness, so arbitrary label collision does not preserve a conditional constant of two. For X=z,Y=(y0,y1), the witness retains H(S_Y|S_X)=2-(3/8)log2(3) and I_Y=1/2.
